reported_continuity.summary: RFE/RL says opposition supporters had rallied in Yerevan and other Armenian cities since the November ceasefire agreement; CivilNet says protests were ongoing after the trilateral agreement.

summary: The resignation campaign is described as beginning after the November ceasefire, but December coverage does not establish uninterrupted physical gatherings between dates or the first qualifying ≥50-person event. Treat this as campaign linkage only, not a continuous occupation/assembly.
notes: Do not infer physical continuity from campaign rhetoric, separate rallies, or broad organizational activity. Exact first qualifying assembly remains unknown; coordinate with November owner/review.

start.summary: RFE/RL reports organizers pitched tents in Republic Square on 22 December; later NEWS.am search result says the dismantled tent had been set up on 22 December.

continued_beyond_month.summary: Later NEWS.am result says the tent was dismantled about two months after being set up and struggle would continue; exact date and article publication date are not captured.

summary: A sit-in/tent camp began with the 22 December rally and is reported to have continued beyond December. Treat it as continuity of that episode, not a separate event for every day.
notes: Later continuity evidence is search-only. No exact dismantling date; do not use silence or month-end as event end.
